newsitem.title: JAPAN: Shiseido to buy Helene Curtis unit for Y3.5-4 bln.
newsitem.headline: Shiseido to buy Helene Curtis unit for Y3.5-4 bln.

text.p: Shiseido Co Ltd said on Monday it had agreed to buy one of Helene Curtis Industries Inc's Japanese units for an estimated 3.5 to 4.0 billion yen.
Helene Curtis, specialising exclusively in products for hair salons, is a unit of Unilever NV.

Shiseido, a leading Japan cosmetics firm, reached an agreement with Unilever to acquire 100 percent of the shares, along with all products and trademark rights of Helene Curtis Japan, one of two Helene Curtis units in Japan.

Unilever was planning to pull out of the hair salon products business in order to focus on general retail operations, while Shiseido wanted to reinforce its domestic hair salon business, Shiseido said.
It added that Helene Curtis Japan is well established in the Japanese hair salon market with several well-known brands for permanent waves, hair dyes and other haircare products.
